papers.title: Efficacy, safety, and outcomes of endoscopic submucosal dissection for inflammatory bowel disease-associated colorectal neoplasia: a systematic review and meta-analysis comparing Asian and Western outcomes
papers.authors: Martins M, Nunes M, Macedo G, Pioche M, Jacques J, Geyl S
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) is increasingly being adopted worldwide for the treatment of colorectal neoplasia. However, its role in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) remains debatable, due to chronic inflammation-related fibrosis, potentially affecting outcomes. This study aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of ESD for colorectal neoplastic lesions in IBD patients, comparing Asian and Western settings.
METHODS: A systematic review was conducted by searching MEDLINE and Web of Science until January 2025, in accordance to MOOSE guidelines. We included primary studies reporting ESD performance in IBD patients. We performed random-effects meta-analysis for several outcomes, including en-bloc, R0, and curative resection rates, frequency of adverse events (post-procedural bleeding and perforation), local recurrence, and need for additional surgery after ESD. Certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE.
RESULTS: We included 20 studies (565 patients and 732 lesions). The meta-analytical frequencies of en-bloc, R0, and curative resection rates were 95.7% (95% CI = 93.5-97.9%; I2 = 60.1%), 84.6% (95% CI = 79.4-90.1%; I2 = 68.9%), and 83.9% (95% CI = 76.3-92.4%; I2 = 75.9%), respectively. Postprocedural bleeding and perforation occurred in 7.0% (95% CI = 4.4-11.2%; I2 = 16.9%) and 7.9% (95% CI = 5.3-11.9%; I2 = 2.4%) of cases, respectively. Local recurrence frequency was 5.3% (95% CI = 3.5-7.9%; I2 = 0%). The meta-analytical need for additional surgery was 13.3% (95% CI = 9.5-18.1%; I2 = 42.5%). No differences were found between Asian and Western studies for any outcome. The certainty of evidence was considered "low" in four outcomes and "very low" in the remaining outcomes.
CONCLUSION: ESD may be feasible and safe for treating IBD-associated colorectal neoplasias, but the available evidence is limited. Similar results were observed between Asian and Western studies.

papers.title_zh: 內視鏡黏膜下剝離術（ESD）治療發炎性腸道疾病相關大腸直腸腫瘤之療效、安全性與預後：亞洲與西方結果比較之系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
前言：內視鏡黏膜下剝離術（ESD）在全球治療大腸直腸腫瘤的應用日益增加。然而，其在發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者中的角色仍有爭議，因慢性發炎相關纖維化可能影響治療結果。本研究旨在評估ESD治療IBD患者大腸直腸腫瘤性病灶的療效與安全性，並比較亞洲與西方的結果。
方法：依循MOOSE指引，檢索MEDLINE與Web of Science至2025年1月，進行系統性回顧。納入報告IBD患者接受ESD治療結果之原始研究。針對多項結果進行隨機效應統合分析，包括整塊切除（en-bloc）、R0切除、根治性切除率、不良事件發生率（術後出血與穿孔）、局部復發，以及ESD後需追加手術之比例。證據等級以GRADE評估。
結果：共納入20篇研究（565名患者、732處病灶）。統合分析之整塊切除率、R0切除率與根治性切除率分別為95.7%（95% CI = 93.5-97.9%；I2 = 60.1%）、84.6%（95% CI = 79.4-90.1%；I2 = 68.9%）、83.9%（95% CI = 76.3-92.4%；I2 = 75.9%）。術後出血與穿孔發生率分別為7.0%（95% CI = 4.4-11.2%；I2 = 16.9%）與7.9%（95% CI = 5.3-11.9%；I2 = 2.4%）。局部復發頻率為5.3%（95% CI = 3.5-7.9%；I2 = 0%）。統合分析之追加手術需求為13.3%（95% CI = 9.5-18.1%；I2 = 42.5%）。亞洲與西方研究在任何結果上均無顯著差異。四項結果之證據等級為「低」，其餘結果為「非常低」。
結論：ESD治療IBD相關大腸直腸腫瘤可能可行且安全，但現有證據有限。亞洲與西方研究結果相似。
papers.score_reason: 統合分析納入20篇多為單臂病例系列，證據等級低至極低、異質性高，但為IBD相關腫瘤ESD決策提供目前最完整的彙總數據。
papers.relevance_why: IBD相關大腸直腸腫瘤是否可用ESD取代全大腸切除，是大腸直腸外科臨床常遇到的決策困境。
papers.one_liner: 在565名IBD患者、732處病灶接受ESD的統合分析中，根治性切除率83.9%，追加手術需求13.3%，局部復發5.3%，亞洲與西方無差異。
papers.action: 對可內視鏡處理的IBD相關腫瘤性病灶，可與內視鏡團隊討論ESD選項，但需告知病人約13.3%仍可能需追加手術。

papers.title: Dietary Titanium Dioxide (E171) Alters the Colon Transcriptome-Evidence From a Human Dietary Intervention Study
papers.authors: Bischoff N, Undas A, van Bemmel G, van Herwijnen M, Verheijen M, Van Breda S
papers.abstract: Food-grade titanium dioxide (E171) has been removed from the European food market due to concerns about its potential genotoxicity, yet human evidence remains limited. Given its continuous use outside the European Union, clarifying its potential hazard is essential for human risk assessment. In a randomized crossover study, 31 adults consumed 2 mg/kg body weight/day of E171 for 2 weeks, with biospecimens collected after both control and exposure periods. Oral intake resulted in elevated titanium concentrations in feces (CTRL: 6.3 mg/kg; E171: 377 mg/kg). Particle characterization showed a median size of 228 nm, with 9% <100 nm. Systemic oxidative stress increased, evidenced by increased superoxide radical levels in whole blood (p = 0.057). Transcriptomic profiling of colon biopsies revealed activation of 73 pathways linked to oxidative stress, cellular metabolism, and colorectal cancer-associated processes. The observed transcriptional changes were consistent with findings of its proposed mode of action. This human intervention study characterizes the effects of dietary E171 following human gastrointestinal digestion and provides evidence that exposure to dietary E171 induces systemic oxidative stress and transcriptional changes in the colon. These findings strengthen regulatory concerns about E171 as a food additive and its potentially harmful effects on human gastrointestinal health.
papers.title_zh: 飲食中的二氧化鈦(E171)改變大腸轉錄體——一項人體飲食介入試驗的證據
papers.abstract_zh: 食品級二氧化鈦(E171)因潛在基因毒性疑慮已自歐洲食品市場下架，然而人體證據仍有限。鑑於其在歐盟以外地區持續使用，釐清其潛在危害對人體風險評估至關重要。在一項隨機交叉試驗中，31名成人每日攝取2 mg/kg體重的E171，為期2週，並於對照期與暴露期後皆採集生物檢體。口服攝取導致糞便中鈦濃度升高(對照組：6.3 mg/kg；E171組：377 mg/kg)。顆粒特性分析顯示中位粒徑為228 nm，9%小於100 nm。全血中超氧自由基濃度上升，顯示全身性氧化壓力增加(p = 0.057)。大腸切片轉錄體分析顯示73條與氧化壓力、細胞代謝及大腸直腸癌相關過程有關的路徑被活化。觀察到的轉錄變化與其提出的作用機轉一致。此人體介入試驗描述了經人體腸胃消化後飲食性E171的效應，並提供證據顯示飲食性E171暴露會誘發全身性氧化壓力及大腸轉錄變化。這些發現強化了對E171作為食品添加劑及其對人體腸胃健康潛在有害效應的法規疑慮。
papers.score_reason: 雖為隨機交叉設計，但樣本小(n=31)、介入期短(2週)，僅提供機轉層次證據（轉錄體、氧化壓力），無臨床結局，對外科臨床決策幾無立即實用性。
papers.relevance_why: 此為食品添加物毒理機轉研究，非手術或藥物治療介入，未涉及大腸直腸癌病人的臨床處置或手術決策。
papers.one_liner: 在31名健康成人的隨機交叉試驗中，比較攝取E171(2mg/kg/day) 2週與對照，發現糞便鈦濃度升高(377 vs 6.3mg/kg)且活化73條致癌相關路徑。
papers.action: 目前不需改變臨床做法；此為食品添加物毒理機轉研究，非手術或治療介入，可留意未來法規動向。

papers.title: Effect of Digital Health Interventions on the Nutritional Status and Quality of Life of Patients With Colorectal Cancer: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
papers.authors: Feng X, Wang J, Shi H, Liang R, Zheng W, Han L
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Digital health interventions may improve clinical outcomes in patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), but their impact on nutritional status (NS) and quality of life (QoL) remains unclear.
OBJECTIVE: This study systematically evaluated the impact of digital health interventions on the NS and QoL in patients with CRC.
METHODS: A systematic search was performed across PubMed, Embase, Cochrane, and Web of Science from inception to March 2026 to identify randomized controlled trials evaluating digital health interventions on NS or QoL in CRC. Two reviewers independently performed screening, data extraction, and risk of bias assessment (Cochrane Risk of Bias Assessment Tool [RoB 1.0]). Meta-analysis used a random-effects model to compute standardized mean differences (SMD) or mean differences (MD) with 95% CIs. Heterogeneity was assessed using I² and τ², and subgroup analyses (intervention duration, intervention method, and scale type) explored sources of heterogeneity. GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation) was used for evidence quality.
RESULTS: Eleven RCTs from 7 countries, involving 1210 participants aged 37.7-69.0 years. The meta-analysis shows that digital health interventions have no significant effect on improving NS (MD 2.23, 95% CI -10.50 to 14.97; P=.27), with high heterogeneity (I²=81.8%). The overall analysis of QoL shows that digital health interventions significantly improve the QoL of patients (SMD 0.67, 95% CI 0.14-1.21; P=.02), with a moderate effect size, but there is high heterogeneity (I²=92.9%; τ²=0.5146; 95% prediction intervals -1.04 to 2.38). Subgroup analysis indicates in terms of intervention duration, the effect is not significant in the group with ≤1 month, while it is significant in the groups with 1-3 months and >3 months, but there is no statistical significance in the differences among subgroups (P=.67); in terms of intervention methods, the group with guided intervention has a significant effect and no heterogeneity (SMD 1.16, 95% CI 1.05-1.28; I²=0%, τ²=0, P=.97), the effect of the unsupervised intervention group is zero, and the effect of the combined intervention group is unstable, with significant differences among subgroups (P<.001); in terms of scale types, different QoL measurement tools have certain effects on the effect size, but the differences among subgroups are not significant (P=.99).
CONCLUSIONS: Digital health interventions have a moderate effect on improving the QoL in patients with CRC, especially when guided interventions are employed, the effect is clearer and more stable. This innovatively identifies "guided intervention models" as a key moderator of efficacy, contrasting with prior reviews that focused solely on technology. Our findings provide new evidence highlighting the importance of interpersonal support in digital health applications. In practice, digital tools should integrate professional medical guidance and supervision rather than being implemented in isolation, to more effectively improve health outcomes in patients with CRC.

papers.title_zh: 數位健康介入對大腸直腸癌（CRC）患者營養狀態與生活品質之影響：隨機對照試驗之系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：數位健康介入可能改善大腸直腸癌（CRC）患者的臨床結果，但其對營養狀態（NS）與生活品質（QoL）的影響仍不明確。目的：本研究系統性評估數位健康介入對CRC患者NS與QoL的影響。方法：系統性檢索PubMed、Embase、Cochrane及Web of Science資料庫，自建庫至2026年3月，納入評估數位健康介入對CRC患者NS或QoL影響之隨機對照試驗。由兩位審閱者獨立進行篩選、資料擷取與偏誤風險評估（Cochrane RoB 1.0工具）。統合分析採用隨機效應模型計算標準化平均差（SMD）或平均差（MD）及其95%信賴區間。異質性以I²與τ²評估，並以介入時長、介入方式與量表類型進行次群組分析以探討異質性來源。證據品質以GRADE評估。結果：共納入來自7個國家的11篇RCT，共1210名參與者，年齡37.7至69.0歲。統合分析顯示數位健康介入對改善NS無顯著效果（MD 2.23，95% CI -10.50至14.97；P=.27），異質性高（I²=81.8%）。整體QoL分析顯示數位健康介入顯著改善患者QoL（SMD 0.67，95% CI 0.14-1.21；P=.02），效果量為中度，但異質性高（I²=92.9%；τ²=0.5146；95%預測區間-1.04至2.38）。次群組分析顯示：就介入時長而言，≤1個月組效果不顯著，1-3個月與>3個月組效果顯著，但次群組間差異無統計意義（P=.67）；就介入方式而言，引導式介入組效果顯著且無異質性（SMD 1.16，95% CI 1.05-1.28；I²=0%，τ²=0，P=.97），非監督式介入組效果為零，混合式介入組效果不穩定，次群組間差異顯著（P<.001）；就量表類型而言，不同QoL測量工具對效果量有一定影響，但次群組間差異不顯著（P=.99）。結論：數位健康介入對改善CRC患者QoL有中度效果，尤其在採用引導式介入時效果更明確且穩定。本研究創新性地將「引導式介入模式」定義為療效的關鍵調節因子，與過去僅聚焦於科技本身的文獻不同。本研究結果提供新證據，強調人際支持在數位健康應用中的重要性。實務上，數位工具應結合專業醫療引導與監督，而非單獨實施，方能更有效改善CRC患者的健康結果。

papers.title: Neoadjuvant anti-PD-1 monotherapy followed by watch-and-wait strategy in dMMR/MSI-H colorectal cancer: a multicenter real-world study
papers.authors: Li T, Zhang H, Wei P, Feng W, Zhang H, Ma S
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the long-term results of the watch-and-wait (W&W) strategy in patients with clinical stage II/III mismatch repair deficiency (dMMR) or microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) colorectal cancer (CRC) who received neoadjuvant anti-PD-1 monotherapy.
METHODS: This retrospective study enrolled stage II/III dMMR/MSI-H CRC patients from four Chinese tertiary hospitals between August 1, 2020 and February 28, 2025. All participants received neoadjuvant anti-PD-1 monotherapy followed by W&W approach. post hoc, endoscopic complete response (eCR) was defined as no suspicious mucosal lesion on white-light or chromoendoscopy (flat scar or normal mucosa allowed) and negative targeted biopsies from the primary tumor site. The primary outcomes were disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS). The study is registered in the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (www.chictr.org.cn ChiCTR2500100474).
RESULTS: A total of 49 patients managed with W&W strategy were enrolled, and all met the post hoc eCR criteria. Radiological evaluation showed clinical complete response in 21 patients (44%), partial response in 17 (35%) and stable disease in 10 (21%). One patient lacked evaluable imaging. Median neoadjuvant treatment duration was 6 months (IQR 4-8), with a median of 12 treatment cycles (IQR 8-16). Treatment-related adverse events were grade 1-2 in 14 patients (29%); no grade 3-4 events occurred. At a median follow-up of 35 months (range 9-60), no local regrowth, distant metastasis, or death was recorded. The estimated 3-year DFS and OS are both 100%.
CONCLUSION: In this cohort, patients with dMMR/MSI-H CRC who met eCR after neoadjuvant anti-PD-1 monotherapy had excellent long-term outcomes when managed with W&W strategy. These findings support the potential utility of endoscopic assessment for selecting candidates for organ preservation, but prospective validation of standardized criteria is warranted.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在評估接受新輔助抗PD-1單一療法之臨床second II/III期錯配修復缺陷(dMMR)或微衛星不穩定高(MSI-H)大腸直腸癌(CRC)患者，採用觀察等待(W&W)策略之長期結果。方法：本回溯性研究納入2020年8月1日至2025年2月28日期間，來自中國四家三級醫院之second II/III期dMMR/MSI-H CRC患者。所有受試者皆接受新輔助抗PD-1單一療法後採取W&W策略。事後(post hoc)定義內視鏡完全緩解(eCR)為白光或染色內視鏡下無可疑黏膜病灶（允許扁平疤痕或正常黏膜），且原發腫瘤部位標靶切片陰性。主要結果為無病存活期(DFS)與總體存活期(OS)。本研究已於中國臨床試驗註冊中心註冊(ChiCTR2500100474)。結果：共49名採W&W策略管理之患者納入研究，且全數符合事後訂定之eCR標準。影像學評估顯示21名患者(44%)達臨床完全緩解，17名(35%)達部分緩解，10名(21%)為疾病穩定，1名患者缺乏可評估影像。新輔助治療中位持續時間為6個月(IQR 4-8)，中位治療週期為12次(IQR 8-16)。治療相關不良事件於14名患者(29%)為第1-2級，無第3-4級事件發生。中位追蹤35個月(範圍9-60個月)，未記錄到局部再生長、遠端轉移或死亡。估計3年DFS與OS皆為100%。結論：在此世代中，於新輔助抗PD-1單一療法後達到eCR之dMMR/MSI-H CRC患者，以W&W策略管理可獲得優異之長期結果。此發現支持內視鏡評估用於篩選器官保留候選者之潛在效用，但仍需前瞻性驗證標準化標準。

papers.title: A multicohort, biomarker-driven phase 2 trial of personalized total neoadjuvant therapy with targeted agents for high-risk rectal cancer (The TRAINER study)
papers.authors: Ma T, Liu J, Zhang S, Fingerhut A, Song H, Xu X
papers.abstract: This multicohort, single-center, phase II trial explored the efficacy and safety of a biomarker-driven total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) regimen in high-risk locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) patients. The regimen included induction chemotherapy (4 cycles of mFOLFOX6) with targeted agents (bevacizumab for cohort B and cetuximab for cohort C), followed by short-course radiotherapy (25 Gy/5Fx) and consolidation chemotherapy (2 cycles of mFOLFOX6, with cetuximab in cohort C). The primary endpoint was complete response (CR; sustained clinical CR [cCR] + pathological CR [pCR]). Secondary endpoints included compliance, safety, pathological outcomes, and survival. Between April 2021 and October 2024, 90 of 96 patients completed the prescribed treatment. CR was achieved in 36 (18 in cohort B and 18 in cohort C) patients (40%). No grade IV-V toxicity was observed, although three and 41 patients experienced targeted agent-related adverse effects in cohort B and C, respectively. In the two cohorts, 43 and 38 patients underwent curative surgery with sphincter preservation in 39 (90.7%) and 34 (89.5%) patients, respectively. Postoperative complications occurred in seven (16.3%) and five (13.2%) patients, of whom one (2.6%) patient in cohort C received reoperation. This intensified TNT regimen with targeted agents for high-risk LARC patients achieved a satisfactory CR rate with acceptable toxicities and complications.

papers.abstract_zh: 本多隊列、單中心第二期試驗探討生物標記導向之全程新輔助治療（TNT）方案在高風險局部進展期直腸癌（LARC）患者中的療效與安全性。治療方案包括誘導化療（mFOLFOX6，4個週期）併用靶向藥物（B隊列使用bevacizumab，C隊列使用cetuximab），接續短程放療（25 Gy/5次）及鞏固化療（mFOLFOX6，2個週期，C隊列併用cetuximab）。主要終點為完全緩解（CR；持續臨床完全緩解[cCR]+病理完全緩解[pCR]）。次要終點包括順從性、安全性、病理結果及存活。2021年4月至2024年10月間，96名患者中有90名完成規定治療。36名患者達到CR（B隊列18名，C隊列18名），佔40%。未觀察到第IV-V級毒性，但B隊列有3名、C隊列有41名患者出現靶向藥物相關不良反應。兩隊列分別有43名及38名患者接受根治性手術，保肛比例分別為39名（90.7%）及34名（89.5%）。術後併發症分別發生於7名（16.3%）及5名（13.2%）患者，其中C隊列1名（2.6%）患者接受再手術。此強化TNT方案併用靶向藥物於高風險LARC患者達到令人滿意的CR率，毒性及併發症可接受。

papers.title: Synthetically engineered probiotic suppresses colorectal cancer via inhibition of Wnt/β-catenin signaling
papers.authors: Sun Y, Zhao Y, Han K, Hu W, Peng G, Yi S
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most prevalent malignancies globally. Recent breakthrough of synthetic biology stimulates the utilization of engineered bacteria for cancer diagnosis and treatment. We perform a comprehensive fecal metabolomic analysis in CRC mouse models and patients and identify ornithine as a specific metabolic biomarker for tumor development. We subsequently engineer an E. coli Nissle 1917 (EcN)-based bioluminescent reporter via ornithine-responsive tumor detection. For therapeutic intervention, we construct a probiotic system that locally releases Dickkopf 3 (DKK3), a potent Wnt signaling antagonist to retard tumor growth. Oral administration of the bacteria demonstrates reduced tumor burden and improved survival outcomes in multiple preclinical models, and the anticancer efficacy is further confirmed in CRC patient-derived organoids and patient-derived xenograft (PDX) model. Taken together, we develop a novel probiotic platform combing non-invasive diagnostic capability with targeted therapeutic delivery for CRC management, underscoring the strong potential for clinical translation and eventual application in preventive oncology.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）是全球最常見的惡性腫瘤之一。合成生物學的最新突破刺激了工程化細菌在癌症診斷與治療上的應用。我們對CRC小鼠模型與患者進行了全面的糞便代謝體分析，確認鳥胺酸（ornithine）為腫瘤發展的特異性代謝標誌物。隨後，我們基於大腸桿菌Nissle 1917（EcN）工程化出一種對鳥胺酸有反應的生物發光報告菌株，用於腫瘤檢測。在治療介入方面，我們構建了一種能局部釋放Dickkopf 3（DKK3，一種強效Wnt訊號拮抗劑）的益生菌系統，以延緩腫瘤生長。口服投予該菌株在多個前臨床模型中顯示腫瘤負荷降低及存活結果改善，其抗癌效力進一步在CRC患者衍生類器官（organoids）及患者衍生異體移植（PDX）模型中得到證實。總結而言，我們開發了一種結合非侵入性診斷能力與靶向治療遞送的新型益生菌平台，用於CRC管理，凸顯其臨床轉譯及最終應用於預防腫瘤學的強大潛力。

papers.title: Bedside Assistant Suction Response and Visual Field Recovery During Robot-Assisted Rectal Cancer Surgery: An Exploratory Propensity Score-Matched Comparison of Assistant-Access Workflows Using Hinotori and da Vinci Xi
papers.authors: Miyagi M, Uchima Y, Henna T, Eguchi M, Ikehara Y
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Timely suction is essential when bleeding or oozing obscures the operative field during robot-assisted rectal cancer surgery; assistant-access workflow may influence the response.
METHODS: This exploratory, retrospective, matched cohort study compared a hinotori workflow with an additional assistant port and a conventional da Vinci Xi port configuration. Eleven hinotori and 82 da Vinci Xi cases were eligible. Propensity score matching was performed using body mass index, preoperative treatment, and tumor location; 10 matched pairs had analyzable videos. Visual field disturbance was defined as bleeding or oozing obscuring the operative view and requiring suction. The times from event onset to suction initiation and from onset to a restored view were defined as latency and time to recovery, respectively. Event-level outcomes were log-transformed; effect sizes were mean log differences and geometric mean ratios. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests using case-level medians were used for sensitivity analyses.
RESULTS: Overall, 152 events were identified (64 hinotori, 88 da Vinci Xi). The hinotori workflow was associated with shorter latency (mean log difference, -0.633; 95% confidence interval [CI], -1.021 to -0.244; p = 0.001; geometric mean ratio, 0.531; 95% CI, 0.360-0.783) and shorter time to recovery (mean log difference, -0.438; 95% CI, -0.739 to -0.137; p = 0.004; geometric mean ratio, 0.645; 95% CI, 0.478-0.872). Sensitivity analyses yielded consistent results.
CONCLUSION: A hinotori-specific assistant-port workflow was associated with faster suction response and visualization recovery. These exploratory findings require cautious interpretation because of institutional and assistant-related confounding.

前言：在機器人輔助直腸癌手術中，當出血或滲血遮蔽手術視野時，即時抽吸至關重要；助手入路的工作流程可能影響此反應速度。

方法：此為探索性、回溯性配對世代研究，比較hinotori工作流程（增加一個助手孔）與傳統da Vinci Xi孔位配置。共11例hinotori與82例da Vinci Xi病例符合條件。使用身體質量指數、術前治療、腫瘤位置進行傾向分數配對；10對配對病例有可分析的影片。視野障礙定義為出血或滲血遮蔽手術視野且需要抽吸。從事件發生到開始抽吸的時間定義為潛伏期，從事件發生到視野恢復的時間定義為恢復時間。事件層級的結果經對數轉換，效應量以平均對數差異與幾何平均比值表示。使用病例層級中位數進行Wilcoxon符號等級檢定作為敏感度分析。

結果：總共辨識出152個事件（hinotori 64個，da Vinci Xi 88個）。hinotori工作流程與較短的潛伏期相關（平均對數差異，-0.633；95%信賴區間，-1.021至-0.244；p = 0.001；幾何平均比值，0.531；95%信賴區間，0.360-0.783），以及較短的恢復時間（平均對數差異，-0.438；95%信賴區間，-0.739至-0.137；p = 0.004；幾何平均比值，0.645；95%信賴區間，0.478-0.872）。敏感度分析結果一致。

結論：特定於hinotori的助手孔工作流程與較快的抽吸反應及視野恢復相關。由於機構與助手相關的干擾因素，這些探索性發現需謹慎解讀。

papers.title: Imbalanced IgA-IgG class switching recombination: a novel mechanism of gut immune dysregulation in inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Chen K, Qing Y, Gao W, Feng W, Tian J, Wang J
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic intestinal inflammatory disorder with significant disease burden that markedly impairs patients' quality of life. The pathogenesis of IBD is closely associated with hyperactive immunopathological responses. Emerging evidence has established humoral immunity as a crucial contributor to IBD development. Class switch recombination (CSR), the critical process enabling B cells to produce different antibody isotypes, plays a pivotal role in humoral immunity. While healthy intestinal mucosa predominantly contains immunoglobulin A (IgA) that maintains gut homeostasis, immunoglobulin G (IgG) becomes the dominant isotype during IBD and drives chronic inflammation. Therefore, understanding the signals and mechanisms governing antibody CSR may provide deeper insights into IBD pathogenesis. Herein, we review B cell activation pathways, the distinct roles of IgA and IgG in intestinal immunity, CSR-regulating signals, and recent discoveries in the context of IBD, with the aim of identifying novel therapeutic opportunities.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一種慢性腸道發炎性疾病，具有顯著疾病負擔，明顯損害病人生活品質。IBD的致病機轉與過度活化的免疫病理反應密切相關。新興證據顯示體液免疫是IBD發展的重要促成因子。類別轉換重組（CSR）是使B細胞產生不同抗體同型的關鍵過程，在體液免疫中扮演樞紐角色。健康腸道黏膜主要含有免疫球蛋白A（IgA）以維持腸道恆定，而在IBD中免疫球蛋白G（IgG）則成為主導同型並驅動慢性發炎。因此，了解調控抗體CSR的訊號與機制，可能有助於更深入理解IBD致病機轉。本文回顧B細胞活化路徑、IgA與IgG在腸道免疫中的不同角色、CSR調控訊號，以及IBD相關的最新發現，旨在尋找新的治療契機。

papers.title: Optimizing anti-TNF therapy in Behçet's disease: the role of therapeutic drug monitoring
papers.authors: Barešić M, Smiljanić Tomičević L, Kozmar A, Mayer M
papers.abstract: Behçet's disease (BD) is a complex, relapsing multisystem disorder characterized by autoinflammatory features. Because disease-specific diagnostic biomarkers are lacking and clinical presentation varies according to geographic background and organ involvement, diagnosis may be delayed, particularly in non-endemic regions and in patients with atypical manifestations. Therapeutic management is highly individualized and guided by disease severity and dominant organ involvement. Severe, refractory, or organ-threatening disease often requires aggressive immunosuppressive treatment, including targeted biologic therapy with monoclonal anti-tumor necrosis factor (anti TNF) alpha agents such as infliximab and adalimumab. Therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM), based on serum trough drug concentrations and anti-drug antibodies, is routinely used to optimize anti-TNF therapy in inflammatory bowel disease and is increasingly discussed in other immune-mediated inflammatory diseases treated with monoclonal antibodies. In Behçet's disease, however, TDM is not yet standard practice, and Behçet-specific therapeutic trough targets for infliximab and adalimumab have not been validated. Nevertheless, integrating TDM with clinical assessment may support more individualized decision-making by helping distinguish insufficient drug exposure, immunogenicity, and pharmacodynamic failure. In this article, we discuss the rationale for TDM in anti-TNF-treated BD, summarize the current direct and indirect evidence, and propose a cautious, clinically guided approach. papers.abstract_zh: 貝西氏症（BD）是一種複雜、反覆發作的多系統疾病，具有自體發炎特徵。由於缺乏疾病特異性診斷生物標記，且臨床表現依地理背景與受累器官而異，診斷可能延遲，尤其在非流行地區及不典型表現的病人中更為明顯。治療管理高度個人化，依疾病嚴重度與主要受累器官而定。嚴重、難治或器官威脅性疾病常需積極的免疫抑制治療，包括使用單株抗腫瘤壞死因子（anti-TNF）alpha藥物如infliximab與adalimumab的生物製劑治療。治療性藥物監測（TDM），based on血中谷濃度（trough concentration）與抗藥抗體，在發炎性腸道疾病中已常規用於優化anti-TNF治療，並在其他以單株抗體治療的免疫調節性發炎疾病中也日益受到討論。然而，在貝西氏症中，TDM尚非標準做法，且infliximab與adalimumab在貝西氏症特有的治療性谷濃度目標值尚未被驗證。儘管如此，將TDM與臨床評估整合，可能有助於區分藥物暴露不足、免疫原性與藥效學失敗，從而支持更個人化的決策。本文討論anti-TNF治療BD病人中TDM的理論基礎，總結目前直接與間接證據，並提出一個謹慎、以臨床為導向的方法。關鍵詞：貝西氏症；infliximab；adalimumab；anti-TNF治療；治療性藥物監測；谷濃度；抗藥抗體；治療優化。

papers.title: KRAS G12C-mutated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: Current Therapeutic Strategies and Future Directions
papers.authors: Sagawa T, Nagashima H, Fujikawa K
papers.abstract: KRAS G12C mutations define a small but clinically important molecular subset of metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC), accounting for approximately 3% to 4% of cases and remaining associated with substantial unmet need after standard chemotherapy. Although direct KRAS G12C inhibitors have transformed treatment in other tumor types, their activity as monotherapy in mCRC has been modest, largely because colorectal cancer retains strong upstream EGFR and receptor tyrosine kinase dependency with adaptive MAPK pathway reactivation. These observations provide the biologic rationale for combined KRAS G12C and EGFR inhibition. Clinical results are line- and regimen-dependent: sotorasib plus panitumumab improved progression-free survival compared with standard later-line therapy in the randomized phase 3 CodeBreaK 300 trial, whereas adagrasib plus cetuximab demonstrated clinically meaningful activity in KRYSTAL-1 but did not improve progression-free or overall survival versus chemotherapy in the second-line phase 3 KRYSTAL-10 trial despite a higher objective response rate. Available evidence should therefore be interpreted with appropriate caution. Moreover, acquired resistance remains common and frequently polyclonal, involving secondary KRAS alterations, receptor tyrosine kinase bypass, and downstream pathway reactivation. In this review, we summarize the biologic rationale, current clinical evidence, practical guideline-based positioning, toxicity management considerations, resistance mechanisms, and emerging therapeutic strategies for KRAS G12C-mutated mCRC.

papers.title_zh: KRAS G12C突變轉移性大腸直腸癌：現行治療策略與未來方向
papers.abstract_zh: KRAS G12C突變定義了轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）中一個小而具臨床重要性的分子亞群，約占所有病例的3%至4%，且在標準化療後仍存在顯著未被滿足的醫療需求。儘管直接KRAS G12C抑制劑已改變其他腫瘤類型的治療方式，其單藥治療在mCRC中的活性有限，主要因為大腸直腸癌仍高度依賴上游EGFR與受體酪胺酸激酶訊息傳導，並具有適應性MAPK路徑再活化能力。這些觀察結果提供了合併KRAS G12C與EGFR抑制的生物學理論基礎。臨床結果依治療線別與用藥組合而異：在隨機分派第三期CodeBreaK 300試驗中，sotorasib併用panitumumab相較於標準後線治療改善了無惡化存活期（PFS）；相對地，adagrasib併用cetuximab在KRYSTAL-1試驗中展現具臨床意義的活性，但在第二線第三期KRYSTAL-10試驗中，儘管客觀反應率（ORR）較高，卻未能改善PFS或整體存活期（OS），相較於化療組。因此現有證據應審慎解讀。此外，後天抗藥性仍相當常見且常呈多株性，涉及次發性KRAS變異、受體酪胺酸激酶旁路活化，以及下游路徑再活化。本篇綜述整理了KRAS G12C突變mCRC的生物學理論基礎、現行臨床證據、依指引之實務定位、毒性管理考量、抗藥機轉，以及新興治療策略。

papers.title: EVIDENCE OF THE INFLUENCE OF GLUCAGON-LIKE PEPTIDE ANALOGS IN INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE: A SCOPING REVIEW
papers.authors: Rezende L, Adour C, Bertoldi G, Brito M, Conceição F, Pacheco M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Inflammatory bowel disease is a chronic, immune-mediated condition characterized by relapsing intestinal inflammation and progressive tissue damage. Despite advances in biological and small-molecule therapies, a considerable proportion of patients experience suboptimal response, treatment intolerance, or persistent disease activity. In parallel, the growing prevalence of obesity and type 2 diabetes among individuals with inflammatory bowel disease has raised interest in therapeutic agents capable of modulating both metabolic dysfunction and intestinal inflammation. Glucagon-like peptide-1 and glucagon-like peptide-2 receptor agonists have demonstrated anti-inflammatory and intestinotrophic properties in experimental and clinical settings, suggesting a potential role in this population.
OBJECTIVE: To systematically map and synthesize current scientific evidence regarding the effects of glucagon-like peptide-1 and glucagon-like peptide-2 receptor agonists in patients with inflammatory bowel disease.
METHODS: A scoping review was conducted following established methodological frameworks for evidence synthesis. A comprehensive search of electronic databases was performed to identify pre-clinical, observational, and interventional studies evaluating the effects of glucagon-like peptide-1 and glucagon-like peptide-2 receptor agonists in inflammatory bowel disease. Studies were screened according to predefined eligibility criteria. Data extraction focused on mechanisms of action, inflammatory markers, clinical outcomes, safety profile, and therapeutic implications.
RESULTS: Pre-clinical studies consistently demonstrated that glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists reduce intestinal inflammation through modulation of immune signaling pathways, suppression of pro-inflammatory cytokines, and enhancement of epithelial barrier integrity. Observational human studies suggest potential clinical benefits, including reduction in disease activity and decreased need for corticosteroid escalation in selected patients. Glucagon-like peptide-2 analogs showed pronounced effects on mucosal regeneration, epithelial proliferation, and improved nutrient absorption, particularly in patients with Crohn's disease and intestinal failure. Overall, the available evidence indicates promising metabolic and intestinal benefits; however, most studies were limited by small sample sizes and heterogeneous designs.
CONCLUSION: Glucagon-like peptide-based therapies represent a promising adjunctive strategy in inflammatory bowel disease due to their anti-inflammatory and regenerative properties. Nevertheless, high-quality randomized controlled trials focusing on diseasespecific clinical, endoscopic, and safety outcomes are necessary to establish their efficacy and therapeutic positioning in routine care.

papers.title_zh: 升糖素樣胜肽類似物對發炎性腸道疾病影響之證據：一篇範疇性文獻回顧（Scoping Review）
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：發炎性腸道疾病是一種慢性、免疫介導的疾病，特徵為反覆發作的腸道發炎與漸進性組織損傷。儘管生物製劑與小分子藥物治療已有進展，仍有相當比例的病人反應不佳、治療不耐受或疾病活性持續存在。同時，IBD病人中肥胖與第二型糖尿病盛行率的上升，引發對能同時調節代謝異常與腸道發炎之治療藥物的興趣。升糖素樣胜肽-1（GLP-1）與升糖素樣胜肽-2（GLP-2）受體促效劑在實驗與臨床情境中已展現抗發炎與腸道滋養特性，顯示其在此族群中可能扮演角色。目的：系統性地整理與統合現有關於GLP-1與GLP-2受體促效劑於IBD病人中效果的科學證據。方法：依循既定的證據綜整方法架構進行scoping review。透過全面搜尋電子資料庫，找出評估GLP-1與GLP-2受體促效劑於IBD中效果的臨床前、觀察性與介入性研究。依預先設定的納入條件篩選研究。資料萃取聚焦於作用機轉、發炎指標、臨床結果、安全性及治療意涵。結果：臨床前研究一致顯示GLP-1受體促效劑透過調節免疫訊息傳導路徑、抑制促發炎細胞激素及增強上皮屏障完整性來減少腸道發炎。人體觀察性研究顯示可能的臨床效益，包括在特定病人中降低疾病活性及減少類固醇升階治療的需求。GLP-2類似物則對黏膜再生、上皮增生及營養吸收改善具有明顯效果，特別是在克隆氏症合併腸衰竭的病人中。整體而言，現有證據顯示出有希望的代謝與腸道效益；然而，多數研究受限於樣本數小與研究設計異質性。結論：以GLP為基礎的療法因其抗發炎與再生特性，代表IBD的一種有前景的輔助策略。然而，仍需要針對疾病特異性臨床、內視鏡及安全性結果的高品質隨機對照試驗，以確立其療效與在常規照護中的治療定位。
